newsitem.title: PANAMA: SOCCER-CUBA BEAT PANAMA ON DELY VALDEZ OFF DAY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CUBA BEAT PANAMA ON DELY VALDEZ OFF DAY.

text.p: Panama's top player Julio Cesar Dely Valdez had a miserable day, missing a series of goal scoring chances, as his team was beaten 3-1 by Cuba in a World Cup soccer qualifier on Sunday.
Dely Valdez, who plays for French club Paris St. Germain, missed four clear cut scoring chances in the semifinal round group two match, much of which was played in a tropical downpour.
Cuba, beaten 5-0 by El Salvador in their first game in the group, took the lead just before halftime when Eduardo Cebranco scored with a header.
Dely Valdez's brother Jorge, who plays his club football in Japan, equalised in the 55th minute but Cebranco put Cuba back in front with a powerful drive in the 73rd minute.
Two minutes from the end, Manuel Bobadillo scored a third for Cuba to condemn Panama to their second straight defeat.
The top two in the group, which also includes Canada, go into the final six-team playoff which will decide the three CONCACAF representatives at the 1998 World Cup finals.
